artifact_observations.reasoning: The cluster of red/yellow/green plants appears overly saturated and structurally 'floating' or fused with the rock, lacking realistic root integration or shadowing. It resembles AI-generated 'noise' rather than natural flora.
The hiker's lower body and trekking poles blend slightly into the rocky ground, with indistinct boundaries suggesting minor generation artifacts in fine details.
Slight warping in the vertical lines of the rock strata, though this could also be lens distortion; marked as low severity artifact due to AI tendency to warp straight lines.
